'''Gnorts''' were herbivorous herd animals from [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].

Gnort meat was comestible. The cookbook ''[[Essential Cooking Skills]]'' detailed how to best cook that meat.<ref name="SWG:ECS">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=item|ESSENTIAL COOKING SKILLS}}</ref> These creatures were sold as dried meat by [[Tasty Dried Critters]] franchise on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="SWG:TDC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Tasty Dried Critters|Tatooine}}</ref>
